resources.string: Optionally transfer exact chapter completion, tracker links, metadata, remote library references and import evidence through a compatible server. Select content and check the signed-in server before enabling. Reading position and existing sync controls stay separate.

Resolve source edition, chapter, tracker or library identities in their review workflows before trying again. A stale upload can be checked with Resume pending upload. An upload that cannot be verified remains paused.
Send the saved upload again with its original content. A conflicting upload will be checked against the latest server state. Use Sync now later to send new changes.
Off by default. Only literal private or loopback addresses are accepted.
HTTP sends your sign-in token and reading data without encryption. Enable only for a private or loopback server you deliberately trust. HTTPS remains available without this option.
